payload.core_composition_summary: Monotonic stacks to find next/prev smaller bounds; memoized DP to compute max increasing/decreasing sums from each peak; then greedy max selection.
payload.rationale: The solution uses monotonic stacks to obtain nearest smaller elements, then recursively computes DP with memoization for left/right optimal sums, combining the two techniques to achieve O(n) for the constrained skyscraper problem.
